distributions.name: σ (\nu \to 1\eta + X)
distributions.provenance: MicroBooNE:2023ubu — first measurement of eta meson production in neutrino-argon interactions with MicroBooNE · signal: at least one eta in the final state on argon, per nucleon, inclusive of CC+NC (98.6% numu CC in simulation), flux-integrated over the MicroBooNE BNB flux (mean E_nu ~0.8 GeV) · sigma(nu -> 1 eta + X) = 3.22 +/- 0.84(stat) +/- 0.86(syst) x10^-41 cm^2/nucleon (BR-corrected total from the 2-gamma channel using BR(eta->2gamma)=39.41%); err = sqrt(stat^2+sys^2) = 1.20 · transcribed from the paper
distributions.notes: Signal: at least one eta in the final state on argon, per nucleon, inclusive of CC+NC (98.6% numu CC in simulation), flux-integrated over the MicroBooNE BNB flux (mean E_nu ~0.8 GeV). Sigma(nu -> 1 eta + X) = 3.22 +/- 0.84(stat) +/- 0.86(syst) x10^-41 cm^2/nucleon (BR-corrected total from the 2-gamma channel using BR(eta->2gamma)=39.41%); err = sqrt(stat^2+sys^2) = 1.20. Transcribed from the paper.
